verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no native pipeline runner. Its documented CI path is a first-party Buildkite integration, which shows builds on a repository's CI tab and as pull-request checks. GitHub Actions results from synced repos also arrive as checks. Together these give some centralized visibility of pipelines executed elsewhere. Missing for 10: platform-hosted runners, documented private/self-hosted runner registration managed by GitCafe, native pipeline execution, independent corroboration.
